title: Conditional fourth-power step
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, encode its first decoded component together with a second component chosen as follows: use four concatenated copies of its second decoded component if, after encoding the first component with those four copies, the second decoded component has length at most the first; otherwise use the original second decoded component.
